instruction: Locate the BibTeX entries for each of the 6 papers cited in the thesis using DBLP, favoring sources other than arXiv, and add them to 'references.bib' separated by blank lines.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding BibTeX entries on DBLP for all 6 papers listed in references.docx. The evaluator extracts BibTeX entries from references.bib and verifies they correspond to the papers cited in references.docx. Expected: at least 6 valid entries matching: Spider, SParC, CoSQL, Attention is All you Need, BERT, and GPT-3 (Language Models are Few-Shot Learners). Verification checks: (1) Count >= 6 entries, (2) Each entry has valid title and type fields, (3) Entry titles/authors match referenced papers using keyword matching strategies for different paper name formats (datasets, full titles, acronyms).

llm_judge_reasons: Metric correctly handles expected parameter - directly accesses expected.get('min_count') without incorrect nested access
Getter successfully extracts BibTeX entries with title, authors, and type fields using regex parsing
Getter attempts to parse references.docx to dynamically identify cited papers
Getter has robust fallback to known papers list if docx parsing fails (python-docx not available or parsing errors)
Metric verifies entry count >= min_count (6) as first check
Metric validates each entry has required fields (title and type) with partial scoring (0.3) if fields missing

Metric matches BibTeX entries against referenced papers using three strategies: direct substring match, keyword matching for multi-word titles (allowing 1 missing keyword), and word boundary regex matching for acronyms
Metric provides graduated scoring: 1.0 for 100% match, 0.9 for >=80%, 0.7 for >=60%, 0.5 for >=40%, 0.3 for valid entries without content match
Logic is sound and will work correctly at runtime with proper error handling
MINOR COVERAGE GAP: Cannot verify 'preferring non-arxiv sources when available' - no mechanism to check entry source type (arXiv vs conference/journal)
MINOR COVERAGE GAP: Cannot verify 'blank lines between entries' - getter extracts entries but doesn't check formatting/spacing in original file
BibTeX regex may fail on complex entries with nested braces, but handles standard entries correctly
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: To verify non-arXiv preference: Add logic to extract 'archivePrefix' or 'eprint' fields from BibTeX entries and check if non-arXiv alternatives exist for papers that have arXiv entries
To verify blank lines: Modify getter to check raw file content for double newlines (\n\n) between consecutive @entry patterns
Consider more robust BibTeX parsing using bibtexparser library if available, to handle complex nested structures
